items.title: Pietersen joins England's white-ball coaching team
items.summary: England appoint former Ashes-winning batter Kevin Pietersen to their white-ball coaching team in the build-up to the 2027 ICC Cricket World Cup.
items.whyItMatters: Cricket gives XLB a stronger India-relevant sports lane and a reason for repeat sports check-ins.

items.title: 'We're not robots' - why US Open men's contenders have tumbled
items.summary: The chaotic nature of the men's draw has been a sharp contrast to the relative calm of the women's - but anyone can still win the US Open titles.
items.whyItMatters: It adds variety to the sports mix without turning the page into a full sports wire.

items.title: Belgian FA still wants Balogun ban answers
items.summary: Belgium's FA says it still wants answers about why Folarin Balogun was allowed to play against them at the World Cup.
items.whyItMatters: Football creates regular global sports momentum and quick-return storylines.
